record.question: Rule 22 of CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 prohibits every Government Servant to consume any intoxicating drink or drug in public places. What will be the position of 'Public Place' in regard to the following places? (a) An exclusive club meant for members where it is possible to invite non-members as guests. (b) The lodging room and the bar/ restaurant of a hotel.
